install_app_hint: Install this app for quick access and offline play.
update_app_hint: New games and updates are ready.
mode_blocks_description: Place pieces, clear rows and columns.
blocks_instructions: Pick a piece, then tap the board to place it. Fill a row or column to clear it.
blocks_keyboard_hint: Keys 1 to 3 pick a piece, arrow keys aim, Enter places, Escape deselects.
blocks_does_not_fit: That piece does not fit there.
mode_minefield_description: Sweep a safe channel for the tankers.
minefield_intro: Find a safe channel through the mined strait: reveal connected safe water from the Gulf in the west to the open sea in the east.
minefield_cell_empty: Row {row}, column {column}: safe water, no mines nearby
minefield_cell_number: Row {row}, column {column}: safe water, sonar reading {count}
minefield_cell_wrong_flag: Row {row}, column {column}: buoy flag on safe water
minefield_submarine_armed: Tap unexplored water to send the submarine.
minefield_status_start: Tap any water to start. The first tap is always safe.
minefield_status_flag_mode: Flag mode is on: taps place or remove buoy flags.
minefield_status_explosion: Kaboom! A tanker sinks. The crew paddles home in a rubber dinghy.
minefield_status_needs_water: Submarines only work on unexplored water.
minefield_help: Long-press or right-click also places a buoy. Tap a number whose buoys match it to clear the cells around it. Keyboard: arrow keys to move, Enter to reveal, F for a buoy.
minefield_paused_hint: The strait is hidden while the game is paused.
minefield_convoy_label: The tankers sail through the channel
minefield_victory_1: The tankers sail through. {characterName} insists this was the plan all along.
minefield_victory_2: {characterName} sulks behind a buoy and asks for the mines back.
minefield_victory_3: Channel open! {characterName} orders a bigger mine. It is on back-order.
minefield_victory_4: The convoy honks politely at a very grumpy {characterName}.
mode_convoy_description: Steer your tanker past mines and drones.
convoy_how_to: Swipe or tap left and right to change lanes. Dodge mines, gunboats and drones, and grab the oil barrels.
convoy_how_to_keys: Keyboard: arrow keys or A and D. P pauses.
convoy_intro: {characterName} has sent the gunboats. Good luck!
convoy_playfield_label: The strait, seen from above. Tap or swipe left and right to steer the tanker.
mode_merge_description: Merge small boats into giant ships.
merge_instructions: Swipe or use the arrow keys. Two equal ships merge into a bigger one.
merge_mine_rule: Every fifth move, {characterName} drops a mine. Merge right next to it to clear it.
merge_tutorial_submarine: The submarine removes any mine you tap. Merge three or more ships in one move to earn another submarine (you can hold up to {max}).
merge_mine_remove: Remove the mine in row {row}, column {column}
merge_submarine_hint: Tap a mine and the submarine removes it.
merge_event_submarine_earned: Triple merge! You earned a submarine.
merge_mega_message: You built {characterName}'s Mega-Tanker! Keep merging for a higher score.
mode_shootdown_description: Shoot down waves of drones from the ground.
shootdown_how_to: Shoot the drones down before they reach the ground. Drag on the ground to move, and tap the sky to shoot.
shootdown_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: arrow keys or A and D to move, Space to fire, P to pause.
shootdown_playfield_label: Playfield: drones fly in formation across the sky, and your launcher drives along the ground
shootdown_commander_pointing: The commander points at the sky
shootdown_blimp_1: Pop! {characterName}'s blimp drifts off with a sad whistle.
shootdown_blimp_2: {characterName} would like a refund for the blimp.
shootdown_blimp_3: {characterName} sulks. It was a very expensive blimp.
mode_pipeline_description: Keep the oil flowing while pipes break.
pipeline_shutdown_warning: Flow cut! The station shuts down in {seconds} s
pipeline_setup_hint: Rotate the pipes to connect the pumping station to the export terminal. Pumping starts with the first connection.
pipeline_controls_hint: Tap a pipe to turn it. Hold a cracked pipe to repair it with the wrench. Tap a warning marker to intercept the strike.
pipeline_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: arrow keys move, Enter turns a pipe, hold R or Enter on a cracked pipe to repair, I intercepts.
pipeline_repair_toggle_hint: One tap on a cracked pipe keeps the wrench going.
pipeline_gameover_quip: The oversized wrench demands a holiday.
mode_flamingo_description: Flap through the gaps, dive on the refinery.
flamingo_controls_hint: Tap, Space or Up arrow to flap. Over the refinery, stop flapping to dive onto the biggest tank.
flamingo_playfield_label: Flamingo Flight playing field. Tap, Space or Up arrow to flap.
flamingo_approach: Refinery ahead! Stop flapping to dive.
flamingo_approach_warehouse: Wildberries warehouse ahead! Stop flapping to dive.
flamingo_approach_datacenter: Yandex datacenter ahead! Stop flapping to dive.
flamingo_crash_net: Flamingo versus drone net. The net won on points.
flamingo_crash_balloon: Flamingo versus barrage balloon. The balloon won on points.
flamingo_crash_radar: The radar mast saw the flamingo coming. The flamingo did not see the radar mast.
flamingo_crash_pantsir: The Pantsir tower spotted the flamingo first. Air defence works, apparently.
flamingo_crash_ground: Forgot to flap. The ground did not forget to be there.
flamingo_crash_flare: Too close to the flare stack. Feathers now slightly toasted.
flamingo_crash_mast: Flew into the mast beside the target. Feathers now slightly toasted.
flamingo_crash_missed: Missed every tank. The refinery is deeply unimpressed.
flamingo_crash_overshoot: Flew straight past the refinery and ran out of flap.
mode_fury_description: Sling birds at a fortress of blocks.
fury_bird_flamingo_hint: Tap in flight to split into three.
fury_bird_pelican_hint: Flies a higher arc and hits hardest, with a little explosion on impact.
fury_bird_stork_hint: Tap in flight for a burst of speed.
fury_bird_goose_hint: Tap in flight to drop a heavy egg straight down.
fury_bird_falcon_hint: Tap in flight to dive steeply onto a target.
fury_bird_phoenix_hint: Tap in flight to burst into an explosion that blasts nearby blocks apart.
fury_bird_parrot_hint: Tap in flight to turn around and hit the target from behind.
fury_controls_hint: Drag back from the slingshot and let go. Tap while the bird flies to use its trick.
fury_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: arrow keys aim, Space or Enter launches, press again for the trick.
fury_canvas_label: Slingshot field. Arrow keys aim, Space launches.
fury_all_cleared: All prepared levels cleared. The domes never stood a chance. Random levels follow.
fury_endless_intro: Every level after the fifteenth is generated, so the fortresses never run out.
mode_chess_description: Outplay Putin, who loves a rookie mistake. Add cards for chaos.
chess_putin_thinking: Putin stares at the board with great seriousness…
chess_quip_greeting_1: Putin cracks his knuckles and calls this match a special chess operation.
chess_quip_calm_1: Putin nods slowly, as if everything is going exactly to plan.
chess_quip_calm_2: Putin sips tea and pretends he saw that coming.
chess_quip_blunder_1: Putin hangs a piece and calls it 4D chess.
chess_quip_blunder_2: Putin leaves a piece undefended. A strategic sacrifice, obviously.
chess_quip_blunder_3: Putin loses track of a pawn and declares it a tactical retreat.
chess_quip_check_1: Putin announces check with theatrical calm.
chess_quip_check_2: Putin says check and looks very pleased with himself.
chess_quip_takes_1: Putin grabs your piece and quietly declares the square his own.
chess_quip_takes_2: Putin captures a piece. The square votes unanimously to join him.
chess_quip_loses_piece_1: Putin loses a piece and calls it a strategic withdrawal.
chess_quip_loses_piece_2: Putin watches his piece vanish and insists it was never his.
chess_quip_card_1: Putin eyes your card suspiciously and asks whether that is allowed.
chess_quip_card_2: Putin demands the rulebook and finds no mention of cards.
chess_card_plague_description: All pawns of one random team vanish. It could be his. It could be yours.
chess_card_plague_played_you: The plague wipes out all of your pawns!
chess_card_plague_played_putin: The plague wipes out all of Putin's pawns!
chess_card_marriage_crisis_description: Both queens walk out on their kings and leave the board.
chess_card_marriage_crisis_played: Both queens file for divorce and leave the board.
chess_card_gotcha_ball_description: Throw it at an enemy pawn. The pawn joins your side.
chess_card_great_ball_description: Catches an enemy pawn, knight or bishop. The piece joins your side.
chess_card_great_ball_played: Great catch! The piece switches sides.
chess_card_ultra_ball_description: Catches any enemy piece up to a rook. It joins your side.
chess_card_ultra_ball_played: Ultra catch! The piece switches sides.
chess_card_master_ball_description: Catches any enemy piece except the king, even the queen.
chess_card_master_ball_played: Master catch! The piece switches sides.
chess_card_pawn_net_description: Catches the three enemy pawns closest to promotion at once.
chess_card_pawn_net_played: The net hauls in the most advanced pawns. They join you.
chess_card_farmer_revolution_description: Eight farmers drop their pitchforks and stand as extra pawns in front of your army.
chess_card_farmer_revolution_played: The farmers revolt! Eight new pawns join your side.
chess_card_mercenaries_description: Two knights are hired for your side, but your queen walks out. The deal: a queen for two knights.
chess_card_mercenaries_played: Two hired knights arrive. The queen storms off.
chess_card_rigged_election_description: Your most advanced pawn wins in a landslide and becomes a queen, but Putin gets a free knight.
chess_card_rigged_election_played: The pawn wins 99 percent of the vote and is crowned queen. Putin gains a knight.
chess_card_bear_hug_description: Putin's queen is crushed, but your rooks are lost in the scuffle.
chess_card_bear_hug_played: The bear hug crushes Putin's queen. Your rooks fall in the scuffle.
chess_card_refused: {card} cannot be played right now: it would change nothing or leave your king in check.
chess_card_pick_target: Tap one of the highlighted enemy pieces.
chess_vance_message: JD Vance bursts in to announce that you are out of cards. You are not. He takes your {card} anyway and leaves.
chess_instructions: You play white and move first. Tap a piece, then a highlighted square. The usual chess rules apply: checkmate Putin's king to win.
chess_tutorial_cards: Instead of moving a piece you may play one of your three cards, each only once per match. Cards can wipe out pawns, steal pieces for your side or trade one thing for another.
chess_tutorial_vance: Beware: every time you play a card there is a {percent} percent chance that JD Vance bursts in, declares you out of cards and takes it. It is still your turn afterwards.
chess_tutorial_putin: Putin plays decently, but now and then makes a rookie mistake and insists it was 4D chess. Punish it.
chess_gameover_draw: A draw. Nobody had a plan
chess_gameover_putin_win: Putin demands a recount of the board and finds your checkmate unconvincing.
chess_gameover_putin_loss: Putin declares the match a total success and adds that he planned it all along.
chess_gameover_putin_draw: Putin calls the draw a diplomatic breakthrough.
chess_quip_blunder_4: Putin slams the table: “A sacrifice! Only a genius sees why!”
chess_quip_blunder_5: Putin, a piece down, smiles thinly: “Phase one of the plan is complete.”
chess_quip_blunder_6: Putin stares at his hanging piece: “I meant to do that. In another dimension.”
chess_quip_check_3: Putin leans forward: “Check. Shall I explain the rules, or would you like to guess?”
chess_quip_takes_3: Putin snorts: “Did you really think pieces were free? Adorable.”
chess_quip_takes_4: Putin pockets your piece: “Thank you for your donation to the motherland.”
chess_quip_loses_piece_3: Putin hisses: “Enjoy that capture. In four dimensions you will regret it.”
chess_quip_loses_piece_4: Putin shrugs: “Take it. I have plenty. Pieces are like gas: there is always more.”
chess_quip_card_3: Putin sneers: “Cards? You make up the rules as you go. I almost respect it.”
chess_card_javelin_description: Hits any enemy piece up to a rook and destroys it.
chess_card_javelin_played: Direct hit! The piece is gone.
chess_card_bayraktar_description: Hunts down a random enemy knight or bishop and destroys it.
chess_card_bayraktar_played: The drone finds its target and the piece is gone.
chess_card_himars_description: Hits any enemy piece except the king: it and every enemy piece next to it are destroyed.
chess_card_himars_played: Boom! Everything around the target is gone.
chess_card_grain_corridor_description: All your pawns with a free square ahead step forward.
chess_card_grain_corridor_played: The grain ships sail and the pawns march on.
chess_card_lend_lease_description: A rook arrives from overseas, but your two most advanced pawns pay the bill.
chess_card_lend_lease_played: A rook arrives, and the bill takes two of your pawns.
chess_card_frozen_assets_description: Putin's rooks are frozen and leave the board. Your bishops are lost as collateral.
chess_card_frozen_assets_played: Putin's rooks are frozen. Your bishops are collateral damage.
chess_card_trade_war_description: Tariffs on diagonal and L-shaped imports: all knights and bishops of both teams leave the board.
chess_card_trade_war_played: Tariffs galore! All knights and bishops leave the board.
chess_card_art_of_the_deal_description: Every rook changes sides where it stands. Both teams call it a win.
chess_card_art_of_the_deal_played: A beautiful deal, the best deal! All rooks switch sides.
about_fiction_body: This is a work of satire and parody. Public figures appear as cartoon caricatures and all other characters are fictional. Scenes are invented, and nothing a character says is a real quote.
about_satire_body: The jokes aim at governments, bureaucracy and absurd situations, never at people because of their origin, religion or ethnicity. The violence is cartoon-only and bloodless.
gameover_peek_hide: Hide results to see the board
share_downloaded: Image saved. Link copied to the clipboard.
share_failed: Sharing did not work this time.
cameo_xi: Xi Jinping offers {characterName} a replacement strait. Flat-pack, instructions not included.
cameo_zelensky: Zelensky sends a very polite drone to ask whether anyone has tried turning the strait off and on again.
cameo_putin: Putin schedules talks about the strait at a table so long that the far end is in a different time zone.
cameo_merz: Friedrich Merz sets up a working group on {characterName}'s mines. First meeting: next quarter.
cameo_mbs: Mohammed bin Salman offers to buy the whole strait, plus the sea around it, plus the gift shop.
cameo_khamenei: Ali Khamenei closes the strait for a very long tea break. {characterName} was not invited.
cameo_netanyahu: Netanyahu calls an emergency meeting, then a second emergency meeting about the first one.
cameo_erdogan: Erdoğan offers to mediate between {characterName} and the tankers, for a small bridge toll.
cameo_macron: Macron sends {characterName} a strongly worded croissant.
cameo_xi_2: Xi Jinping announces a five-year plan for a bigger strait. The first four years are for paperwork.
cameo_xi_3: Xi Jinping sends {characterName} a tanker in 40,000 flat-packed pieces, one piece delivered per day.
cameo_zelensky_2: Zelensky sends {characterName} a spreadsheet of every ship lost so far, colour-coded, with helpful comments.
cameo_zelensky_3: Zelensky joins the strait summit in his usual sweatshirt. Everyone else wears black tie. {characterName} wears a life jacket.
cameo_putin_2: Putin insists the strait is not closed, merely not yet open. Please stop saying closed.
cameo_putin_3: Putin sends {characterName} a very serious wooden horse as a gift. Please do not look inside.
cameo_merz_2: Friedrich Merz promises to clear the strait by 2040, pending approval from seven committees and one fax machine.
cameo_merz_3: Friedrich Merz promises to clear the mines personally, right after the tax reform, the pension reform and lunch.
cameo_mbs_2: Mohammed bin Salman announces a floating city on the strait. Parking is free; the parking ticket costs a billion.
cameo_mbs_3: Mohammed bin Salman buys the last tanker, then the tanker's tanker, then a smaller tanker for the tanker's tanker.
cameo_khamenei_2: Ali Khamenei reopens the strait, but only on Thursdays, between the first tea and the second tea.
cameo_khamenei_3: Ali Khamenei declares the strait a no-sail, no-fly, no-small-talk zone. {characterName} sails in anyway to chat.
cameo_netanyahu_2: Netanyahu forms a coalition to deal with the strait. It collapses before anyone mentions the strait.
cameo_netanyahu_3: Netanyahu holds a press conference with a cartoon bomb to explain the mines. The mines are not impressed.
cameo_erdogan_2: Erdoğan announces a new bridge over the strait, then a canal beside the bridge, then a toll on the canal.
cameo_erdogan_3: Erdoğan offers {characterName} a free tea, a free baklava and a not-so-free tanker lane.
cameo_macron_2: Macron addresses the nation about the strait for forty minutes, in four tenses, with two croissants for emphasis.
cameo_macron_3: Macron proposes a European strait, with strategic autonomy and a very strategic baguette.
error_lost_body: This page sailed right off the map.
error_broken_body: Only the page got hurt. Try again in a moment.
mode_dronewall_description: Hold the line on eleven maps, some so big they scroll: squads, snipers, mortars, FPV swarms, Patriots, Gepard flak, HIMARS, Pion artillery, jammers, Azov fighters and Leopard tanks. Fog, rain and snow change the fight, elite upgrades unlock F-16 airstrikes and Storm Shadow missiles. Helmets are your only money.
dronewall_playfield_label: Drone Wall playfield. Soldiers march down the road toward your line.
dronewall_ready_hint: Crowds of cartoon soldiers and aircraft are coming. Build on the dashed spots; fallen helmets fly to your counter by themselves.
dronewall_tutorial_goal: Crowds of chunky blob soldiers march down the road toward your line. Every soldier who crosses it costs you a heart.
dronewall_tutorial_build: Tap a dashed spot to build a defense there. Tap a built defense to upgrade or sell it.
dronewall_tutorial_helmets: Every fallen enemy drops a Soviet helmet that flies to your counter on its own. Helmets are the only money for building and upgrading.
dronewall_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: Tab to a spot, Enter to select it, P or Esc to pause.
dronewall_squad_role: Close range, steady fire. Weak against aircraft
dronewall_nest_role: Spams FPV drones that fly to soldiers and dive onto them
dronewall_patriot_role: Long range anti-air missiles. Ground troops are safe from it
dronewall_azov_role: Fighters walk around the post and hold soldiers in melee
dronewall_leopard_role: A heavy tank that rolls around the post and crushes everything in reach
dronewall_tutorial_armor: Shields and armored cars shrug off rifle fire. Mortars, mines, drones and your melee units still hurt them.
dronewall_tutorial_air: Shahed drones and helicopters ignore the road and fly straight at your line. Patriot batteries shoot them down; assault squads can hit them too, but for much less damage.
dronewall_tutorial_speed: The speed button next to the wave counter switches between x1, x2 and x4.
dronewall_speed_label: Game speed x{speed}. Tap to change.
dronewall_trench_role: Slows the crowd, mines from level 2
dronewall_slot_built: Spot {number}: {defense}, level {level}. Select to upgrade or sell.
dronewall_map_tall_hint: This map is several screens tall. Scroll along the road; the strip on the left shows where the enemies are.
dronewall_radar_label: Map overview with the enemies. Tap to scroll there.
dronewall_himars_role: Rocket truck: a salvo of rockets from very far away, then a long reload
dronewall_sniper_role: One precise shot at the toughest soldier. Officers and medics first, armor barely matters
dronewall_jammer_role: Electronic warfare: aircraft in its field crawl and take damage. Useless against soldiers
dronewall_gepard_role: A hail of rounds that shreds aircraft and swarms. Hardly hurts soldiers
dronewall_pion_role: Enormous range and a huge blast, but a very slow rate of fire
dronewall_weather_fog_effect: FPV drones are weaker and see less far
dronewall_weather_rain_effect: Tanks and other vehicles move slower
dronewall_weather_snow_effect: Infantry moves slower and can freeze on the spot
dronewall_power_airstrike_role: F-16 jets carpet-bomb a band of the field. Tap the field where they should strike
dronewall_power_stormshadow_role: A cruise missile that flattens one spot. Tap the field where it should land
dronewall_power_locked: Locked: promote a defense to elite {rank}
dronewall_power_aim: Tap the field to call it in. Tap the button again to cancel.
dronewall_tutorial_elite: Upgrade a defense past level 3 and it turns elite: it looks completely different and gets far stronger, with bigger volleys, more fighters or stronger mines.
dronewall_tutorial_powers: The first elite defense unlocks the F-16 airstrike, an elite II one unlocks the Storm Shadow missile. Tap a power, then tap the field where it should hit. Powers cost a lot of helmets and need time to recharge, but they win a sudden mass assault.
dronewall_tutorial_weather: Every wave brings weather, and you see the forecast while you build. Fog weakens your FPV drones, rain slows tanks and other vehicles (yours too), snow slows infantry and freezes enemy soldiers solid for a moment.
dronewall_tutorial_attackers: Watch out for medics that heal, officers that rush the crowd, sappers that walk through trenches, tanks, buggies, bombers and drone swarms. Every few waves a mass assault storms in all at once.
dronewall_tutorial_tall: Big maps scroll. Swipe along the field, or let the view follow the attack.
mode_parking_description: The harbor is jammed. Slide the ships aside and ease the tanker out.
parking_playfield_label: Harbor grid. Drag ships along their axis to clear a lane for the tanker.
parking_intro: Clear a lane and steer the tanker out of the harbor.
parking_tutorial_goal: The harbor is jammed and the red tanker needs to reach the exit on the right. Rocks never move; every other ship does.
parking_tutorial_drag: Drag a ship along its own axis: sideways ships slide left and right, upright ships slide up and down. Letting go counts as one move, however far you slide.
parking_tutorial_stars: There are no lives. Fewer moves earn more stars: three stars for matching par, the fewest moves possible.
parking_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: Tab to a ship, arrow keys move it one cell.
parking_all_cleared: Every harbor is clear. The tanker is free.
mode_slice_description: Swipe through arcing missiles and drones before they get away. Slice a tanker, balloon or gull by mistake and you lose a heart.
slice_playfield_label: Radar Slice playfield. Swipe across the screen to slice the missiles and drones flying up.
slice_ready_hint: Missiles and drones arc across the radar. Swipe through them, but leave the friendly tankers, balloons and gulls alone.
slice_tutorial_goal: Missiles and drones arc up across the radar screen. Swipe a finger or the mouse through them to cut them in two. Smaller, faster ones are worth more.
slice_tutorial_miss: Every missile or drone that falls back into the sea costs a heart.
slice_tutorial_decoys: Do not slice the friendly tankers, balloons and gulls: every one you cut costs a heart too.
slice_tutorial_combo: Slice several in one swipe for a combo bonus that grows with every extra hit.
slice_keyboard_hint: Slicing needs a finger, pen or mouse. Keyboard: P or Esc to pause.
mode_whack_description: Whack the spokespeople, officials and talking heads before their statements finish. Whack a journalist or an aid worker by mistake and you lose a heart.
whack_playfield_label: Whack-a-Spokesperson playfield. Tap a podium to whack whoever stands behind it.
whack_ready_hint: Pick a board. Whack every spokesperson before the statement bar fills up, but leave the journalists and aid workers alone.
whack_tutorial_goal: Spokespeople, officials and talking heads pop up behind the podiums. Tap them to whack them back down. The shorter the statement, the more the target is worth.
whack_tutorial_statement: Every target comes with a statement bar. If the bar fills up before you whack them, the statement goes out and you lose a heart.
whack_tutorial_decoys: Do not tap the journalists and aid workers: every one you whack costs a heart too. They only drop by and leave on their own.
whack_tutorial_combo: Whack several in quick succession for a combo. Every three hits in a row raise your score multiplier, up to x5. A tap on an empty podium, a decoy or a statement that gets out resets it.
whack_tutorial_boards: Three boards, three backdrops: a ministry briefing room, a hilltop hideout and a press hall by the red wall. The rules are the same, and each board keeps its own best score.
whack_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: the digits 1 to 9 whack the podiums in the order of the grid, P or Esc to pause.
mode_runcomrade_description: Sprint through the sunflower field with a drone on your heels. Swap lanes, jump ditches, duck tractor arms and dodge mines.
runcomrade_playfield_label: Run Comrade playfield. Swipe sideways to change lane, swipe up or tap above the runner to jump, swipe down or tap on the runner to duck.
runcomrade_ready_hint: Swipe left or right to change lane, tap or swipe up to jump, tap low or swipe down to duck. Every stumble lets the drone get closer.
runcomrade_hud_hint: Swipe to dodge, tap to jump or duck
runcomrade_tutorial_goal: A cartoon soldier sprints through a sunflower field while an FPV drone buzzes after him. Run as far as you can; the field gets denser the further you go.
runcomrade_tutorial_controls: The field has three lanes between the sunflower rows. Swipe left or right to change lane. Tap the upper part of the field (or swipe up) to jump, tap the runner or below (or swipe down) to duck.
runcomrade_tutorial_drone: Every stumble lets the drone close in. When it reaches you, you lose a heart, then it falls back a little. Running cleanly slowly shakes it off. Listen for the buzz: it gets quicker and louder when the drone is near.
runcomrade_drone_hint: Chases you from behind. Stumbles bring it closer.
runcomrade_tall_hint: Hide the drone while you run among them. Trust your ears.
runcomrade_helmet_hint: Speed boost: you plow through obstacles and leave the drone behind.
runcomrade_rice_hint: A shield that absorbs the next stumble or drone hit.
runcomrade_tutorial_field: The further you run, the denser the field: faster running, more obstacles and more sunflowers.
runcomrade_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: arrow keys or A and D change lane, Up, W or Space jumps, Down or S ducks, P or Esc pauses.
runcomrade_tutorial_weather: Some stretches run through a pink dawn with long shadows, others through thick, dark fog. Fog shortens your view and can hide a faraway drone, but obstacles always show up in time, and the buzz never goes away.
runcomrade_cameo_alt: Close-up of the runner with wide eyes, an open mouth and sweat drops
runcomrade_cameo_message: He looked back one second too long. The drone did not blink.
mode_beltroad_description: Link the ports with trade routes and leave no cell empty. Every redraw adds to the debt.
beltroad_playfield_label: Route grid. Drag from a port to draw its trade route; every cell has to be filled.
beltroad_intro: Join every pair of ports and fill the whole grid.
beltroad_star_limits: Three stars up to {three} moves, two stars up to {two}.
beltroad_tutorial_title: How to build a trade route
beltroad_tutorial_goal: Every port has a twin. Join each pair with a trade route and cover every single cell of the grid. Routes may not cross or share a cell.
beltroad_tutorial_draw: Press on a port and drag through the cells to draw its route. Letting go counts as one move. Drag back over your own line to pull it in again.
beltroad_tutorial_cut: Drag a route into another route and that one is cut off at the crossing, so you can reroute it. Press on a drawn line to carry on from there.
beltroad_tutorial_stars: There are no lives. Every move adds to the debt: the fewer strokes, the more stars. Three stars for staying close to par, which is one stroke per route.
beltroad_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: Tab to the grid, arrow keys move the cursor, Enter puts the pen down on a port or a route and lifts it again.
beltroad_all_cleared: Every route is built. The debt is somebody else’s problem now.
mode_maze_description: Wander through a maze of offices to find Passierschein B-38. Collect stamps and forms, and beware of offices closed until Tuesday.
maze_playfield_label: Office maze. Swipe, tap an office or use the arrow keys to walk through the doors.
maze_intro: Find the counter with Passierschein B-38. No clock, no lives: only your steps count.
maze_notice_idle: Find the golden counter. Passierschein B-38 is waiting there. Probably.
maze_notice_pickup: Collected: {item}. Keep it safe, nobody will issue another.
maze_notice_locked: This door needs: {item}. Please queue again. (One step lost.)
maze_notice_closed: Closed until Tuesday. It does not say which Tuesday. (One step lost.)
maze_tutorial_goal: You are a clerk in a huge office building. Somewhere in it is the counter with Passierschein B-38 (golden, marked on the map). Get there.
maze_tutorial_move: Swipe in a direction, tap a neighboring office, or use the direction buttons or the arrow keys to walk one office at a time. You only see the offices you have visited and the ones behind their doors.
maze_tutorial_doors: Some doors are locked and show which stamp or form opens them. Those documents lie in other offices and are picked up automatically when you walk in. Once you carry one, every door of that kind opens.
maze_tutorial_closed: Some offices are closed until Tuesday. You only find out by knocking, and then you have to turn around and look for another way.
maze_tutorial_steps: There is no timer and there are no lives. Every step counts, and so does every bump into a locked door or a closed office. The fewer steps, the more stars. Walking into a plain wall is free.
maze_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: arrow keys or W, A, S, D.
maze_win_line: Approved. Please file a copy in triplicate.
mode_purrpentagram_description: Pet five cats gently, read their clues and draw the star in the order the riddle demands. Scrub too hard and they hiss.
purr_playfield_label: Purr Pentagram playfield: five cats sit on the points of a pentagram. Press and hold a cat to pet it, drag from one cat to another to draw the star.
purr_ready_hint: Read the riddle, pet the cats to learn about them, then draw the star from cat to cat in the order the riddle asks.
purr_hud_hint: Hold to pet, drag to draw the star
purr_riddle_title: The Riddle of the Five Cats
purr_riddle_intro: Five cats keep watch by candlelight, each one a point of the star. Call them in the order of the verse:
purr_clue_coat_black: the cat in a coat of midnight
purr_clue_coat_white: the cat as pale as the moon
purr_clue_coat_grey: the cat as grey as ash
purr_clue_coat_tabby: the cat striped like a tiger's shadow
purr_clue_name: the one who answers to the name {name}
purr_clue_purr_0: the one whose purr rumbles deepest, like a bell in a cellar
purr_clue_purr_1: the one whose purr rolls low, just above the deepest
purr_clue_purr_2: the one whose purr hums in the middle of the song
purr_clue_purr_3: the one whose purr sings high, just below the highest
purr_clue_purr_4: the one whose purr is highest, thin as a silver thread
purr_clue_trait_hides_thunder: the one who flees beneath the rug when thunder walks the sky
purr_clue_trait_dozes_dim: the one who drifts into sleep when the lights go low
purr_clue_trait_chases_laser: the one who chases the red dot wherever it runs
purr_clue_trait_hisses_draft: the one who hisses at the cold breath of the window
purr_clue_trait_stares_laser: the one who only watches the red dot, still as stone
purr_clue_quirk_fat: the cat as round as a full moon
purr_clue_quirk_tophat: the cat in the tall velvet hat
purr_clue_quirk_crazy: the cat with eyes that spin like spirals
purr_clue_quirk_glasses: the cat who reads through lenses of glass
purr_clue_quirk_crown: the cat who wears a crown of gold
purr_clue_possessed: the one a spirit has taken, whose eyes burn red
purr_cat_label: Cat: {cat}. Press Space to pet it, Enter to join it to the star.
purr_notice_mistake: Wrong cat! The cats hiss at you.
purr_notice_not_ready: That cat is too upset right now. Pet it gently until it calms down.
purr_notice_out_of_turn: Continue the star from the cat you joined last.
purr_tutorial_goal: Five cats sit on the points of a pentagram. The riddle names them one after the other: join the cats in exactly that order and the star ignites. Every wrong stroke costs a heart, and after three wrong strokes the cats lose patience.
purr_tutorial_petting: Pet a cat by pressing and holding your finger (or the mouse button) on it. The longer you hold, the louder it purrs and the more hearts it earns. The first heart brings out its name tag, the second shows how deep its purr is, which you can also hear.
purr_tutorial_clues: Every line of the riddle is a different kind of clue. Some you read straight off the cat: its coat, what it wears, or the red eyes of the one that is possessed. Names and purrs have to be coaxed out by petting. Habits show when something happens in the room, so watch the cats then. The line to do next tells you what to look for.
purr_tutorial_star: To draw the star, start on a cat and drag out of its circle to the next cat, then continue from there. The cats sit so that the right order always skips one cat at a time. The star is only complete when you draw from the last cat back to the first one.
purr_tutorial_room: Things happen in the room, and every cat reacts in its own way. Some reactions are clues for the riddle, some are just distractions:
purr_tutorial_calm: A cat that hides under the rug or runs off after the laser dot cannot be joined yet, and neither can one that is too upset. Pet it until it calms down. Reduce motion turns off animation and lightning flashes, and the sound button mutes the purrs and the music.
purr_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: Tab moves between the cats, Space pets the cat (hold it for a steady purr), Enter chooses a cat for the star, P or Esc pauses.
purr_win_subtitle: The star burns, and every cat purrs along.
mode_energiewende_description: Run the national grid: balance coal, gas, nuclear, wind, sun and more against a swinging demand, keep the price and the CO2 down and avoid blackouts.
energiewende_biz_calm_1: The price is fine. Suspiciously fine.
energiewende_biz_annoyed_1: Have you seen this price per megawatt hour?
energiewende_biz_annoyed_2: My factory is not a charity!
energiewende_biz_outraged_2: I will move my factory to the moon!
energiewende_woman_mix_outraged_1: Disgusting! Switch off the dirty plants!
energiewende_woman_mix_outraged_2: This mix is a crime against the sky!
energiewende_woman_nuclear_annoyed_1: On, off, on, off? Make up your mind.
energiewende_woman_nuclear_annoyed_2: A reactor is not a light switch.
energiewende_woman_nuclear_outraged_1: Nuclear on, nuclear off, again?! Unbelievable!
energiewende_woman_nuclear_outraged_2: Pick a side on nuclear already!
energiewende_cameo_alt_biz_calm: Cartoon of a stout businessman in a tight suit, calm and satisfied
energiewende_cameo_alt_biz_annoyed: Cartoon of a stout businessman in a tight suit, frowning and annoyed
energiewende_cameo_alt_biz_outraged: Cartoon of a stout businessman in a tight suit, red in the face and outraged
energiewende_cameo_alt_woman_calm: Cartoon of a woman with long black hair, calm
energiewende_cameo_alt_woman_annoyed: Cartoon of a woman with long black hair and a disgusted face
energiewende_cameo_alt_woman_outraged: Cartoon of a woman with long black hair, utterly disgusted with her tongue out
energiewende_chart_label: Supply {supply} GW against demand {demand} GW over the last day
energiewende_event_heatwave_hint: Demand soars for cooling, and warm rivers force nuclear and coal to throttle back.
energiewende_event_dunkelflaute_hint: Dark and windless: wind and sun almost vanish. Bring in gas, hydro, biomass and batteries.
energiewende_event_storm_hint: Wind blows at full strength, then the turbines shut down for safety. Keep a backup ready.
energiewende_event_drought_hint: Hydro output drops and the rivers get too warm for nuclear.
energiewende_event_gascut_hint: Gas plants can deliver far less and the price climbs.
energiewende_event_plantoutage_hint: A plant trips offline suddenly and has to warm up again once it is back.
energiewende_event_bigmatch_hint: Everybody switches on the TV at kick-off: demand jumps for a few hours.
energiewende_event_importsqueeze_hint: The neighbors need their power: imports shrink and get pricier.
energiewende_event_pricespike_hint: Gas and imports get very expensive for a while.
energiewende_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: Tab to a slider, then the arrow keys to adjust it, Page Up and Page Down for bigger steps.
energiewende_over_biz_calm: Lights out, but the price was fair. I will send an invoice anyway.
energiewende_over_biz_annoyed: Dark AND expensive? I want a refund.
energiewende_over_biz_outraged: I paid a fortune for darkness! Never again!
energiewende_over_woman_calm: At least the air was clean while it lasted.
energiewende_over_woman_annoyed: Dark and dirty. Impressive, in a bad way.
energiewende_over_woman_outraged: You burned everything and still had no light. Disgusting!
energiewende_over_woman_nuclear: You flipped the reactor like a light switch, and now the lights are out. Typical.
energiewende_ready_hint: Set the sliders so supply matches demand. If the gap stays open too long, the grid trips.
energiewende_source_hint_coal: – cheap and very dirty. Slow to change and hours to warm up.
energiewende_source_hint_gas: – reacts fast but is pricey and fairly dirty. The classic backup.
energiewende_source_hint_nuclear: – clean and cheap but very slow. Switching it on and off annoys the Critic.
energiewende_source_hint_wind: – nearly free and clean. Only as strong as the wind; you can only throttle it.
energiewende_source_hint_solar: – nearly free and clean. Works by day and under clear skies only.
energiewende_source_hint_hydro: – clean and quick, but limited, and the water level decides.
energiewende_source_hint_biomass: – steady, middling in price and dirt, with a slow ramp.
energiewende_source_hint_batteries: – store surplus power (slide left to charge) and give it back later (slide right). Fast but small.
energiewende_source_hint_imports: – fast but pricey and dirty, and the price follows demand.
energiewende_tutorial_goal: You run the national power grid. Supply has to match demand at every moment, while demand swings through the day and the weather decides how much wind and sun there is.
energiewende_tutorial_sliders: Each source has a slider for how much of its capacity you want. Plants follow slowly at their own ramp speed, so plan ahead. The pale bar shows what a source could deliver right now, the colored bar what it delivers.
energiewende_tutorial_cold: Coal, gas, nuclear and biomass need hours to warm up after a cold start, and go cold again when they trip. Wind, sun and hydro cannot be ordered up, only throttled down.
energiewende_tutorial_stress: When supply and demand drift too far apart, the grid stress bar fills. When it is full, the grid trips: a blackout (too little) or an overload (too much) costs a heart. After a trip the grid gets a short breather.
energiewende_tutorial_events: Headlines warn you a few hours ahead of heatwaves, a Dunkelflaute, storms, plant outages and more. Use the warning.
energiewende_tutorial_critics: Two cartoon critics watch you. The Tycoon hates high prices. The Critic hates a dirty mix and is furious when you switch the nuclear plant on and off again.
energiewende_tutorial_score: You earn points for every hour the grid is steady, more when the power is cheap and clean. The game ends when all your hearts are gone.
mode_centrifuge_description: Nothing ever happens. Watch the dial, shrug off the sirens and BREAKING banners, and act only when the needle really leaves the safe band.
centrifuge_tutorial_goal: You run a centrifuge, and a very calm face keeps you company. Stay calm and keep your hearts.
centrifuge_tutorial_dial: The dial has a green safe band in the middle. As long as the needle stays in it, nothing needs doing, however twitchy it looks.
centrifuge_tutorial_scares: Sirens, BREAKING banners, a shaking screen and a looming Something will try to rattle you. They are all fake. If you press the button during one, you fall for it and lose a heart.
centrifuge_tutorial_fix: Sometimes the needle really drifts out into the red. Then tap anywhere or press Stabilize before it hits the end: the sooner, the more points. Miss it and you lose a heart.
centrifuge_tutorial_score: Every scare you sit through earns points, and every correct decision builds a streak that raises your multiplier. Later the real drifts creep in under the scares, so look at the needle, not the noise. The game ends when your hearts are gone.
centrifuge_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: Space or Enter stabilizes, P pauses.
centrifuge_playfield_label: Control room with a calm face next to a spinning dial
centrifuge_dial_label: Dial with a green safe band in the middle and red zones at both ends
centrifuge_ready_hint: Nothing ever happens. Press Stabilize only when the needle leaves the green band.
centrifuge_status_calm: The dial is in the safe band. Nothing is happening.
centrifuge_status_drift: The dial has left the safe band. Stabilize now!
centrifuge_banner_1: Something is happening, details to follow
centrifuge_banner_3: Sources close to a source confirm a rumor
centrifuge_banner_4: Situation develops, situation continues to develop
centrifuge_banner_5: Unnamed official calls for calm, then panics
centrifuge_banner_6: Markets react to the markets reacting
centrifuge_banner_7: Anchors alarmed at how normal the dial looks
centrifuge_banner_8: Live from a car park: nothing, but urgently
centrifuge_cameo_alt: A cartoon face that stays calm
centrifuge_cameo_message: Nothing ever happens. Until it does. Then you press the button.
mode_venezuela_description: Run, jump and stomp through the oil fields as a very mustachioed president. Collect barrels, squash rig guards, dodge helicopters and reach the flag.
venezuela_intro: Run to the flag. Each finished level opens the next one.
venezuela_ready_hint: Hold the move strip to run (keep holding to sprint) and tap Jump to leap. Tap Jump again in the air to twirl higher, hit Slam to dive.
venezuela_playfield_label: El Presidente playfield: a side-scrolling oil field
venezuela_tutorial_goal: A cartoon president with a magnificent mustache runs through the oil fields. Reach the flag at the end of each level, and grab as many oil barrels as you can on the way.
venezuela_tutorial_controls: Touch the left half of the move strip to run left and the right half to run right; slide a finger between them to turn around. Keep running in one direction and the presidente breaks into a sprint, which carries into long jumps. The round buttons work at the same time.
venezuela_tutorial_jump: Hold Jump for a high jump, tap it for a short hop. Tap Jump once more in the air for a mustache twirl, a second jump. You can still jump for a split second after running off a ledge, and a jump pressed just before landing counts.
venezuela_tutorial_slam: Slam (or swipe down from Jump) in the air: the presidente hangs for a moment, then dives straight down. Landing sends out a shockwave that squashes every rig guard nearby. Squash guards one after another without touching the ground for a combo: each one is worth more.
venezuela_tutorial_stars: Stars: one for finishing, one for collecting every barrel, one for finishing without losing a heart. Falling into a pit costs a heart too, then you restart at the last lamp.
venezuela_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: arrow keys or A/D to run, Space, Up or W to jump (again in the air to twirl), Down or S to slam, P or Escape to pause.
venezuela_goon_hint: Jump on its head to squash it. Touching it from the side costs a heart. Some of them hop.
venezuela_heli_hint: Cannot be stomped. Watch it sweep, shake and swoop, then keep out of its way.
venezuela_spikes_hint: Jump over it; touching it costs a heart.
venezuela_flag_hint: Touch it to finish the level.
venezuela_all_cleared: Every flag is planted. Congratulations, Presidente!
venezuela_cameo_alt: A cartoon president with a huge mustache and spiral eyes
venezuela_cameo_message: Even a presidente runs out of hearts. The mustache, however, is undefeated.
mode_sondage_description: A French election on a map of départements. Hold rallies, flip the rival’s lines like in Othello, watch the poll bar and stop La Candidate from grabbing the majority.
sondage_ready_hint: Tap a free département to hold a rally. Rival tiles in a line between your rally and one of your tiles flip to you. Hold the majority of the map to win.
sondage_poll_aria: Poll: you hold {you} départements, La Candidate {rival}, undecided {undecided}; {needed} are needed for the majority.
sondage_turn_you: Your move: tap a free département to hold a rally.
sondage_action_rival_flip: La Candidate rallied in {name}. Tiles flipped: {count}.
sondage_action_gaffe: Gaffe! La Candidate rallied in {name} by mistake.
sondage_event_scandal_you: Scandal in {name}! Your rally there is frozen this round.
sondage_event_scandal_rival: Scandal in {name}! La Candidate’s rally there is frozen this round.
sondage_event_strike: Strike in {name}! No rallies there. Rounds blocked: {rounds}.
sondage_tile_label_flips: {name}: {state}; tiles a rally here would flip: {count}
sondage_legend_frozen: Frozen rally (scandal): it cannot flip or anchor a line this round.
sondage_legend_blocked: Blocked département (strike): no rallies, and no lines run through it for 2 rounds.
sondage_candidate_alt_neutral: La Candidate, a cartoon politician with a copper hair swoosh, round glasses and a navy sash, smiling politely
sondage_candidate_alt_smug: La Candidate smirking with one eyebrow raised
sondage_candidate_alt_defeated: La Candidate in tears, her hair drooping and her sash crooked
sondage_quote_neutral_1: Every département counts. Especially the ones I have not visited yet.
sondage_quote_neutral_2: My programme is ready. Page one is blank, page two is a surprise.
sondage_quote_smug_1: The polls love me. The polls love everyone who is ahead of them.
sondage_quote_smug_2: I am not saying I have won. I am saying the sash fits.
sondage_quote_worried_1: These polls are within the margin of error. Of a completely different poll.
sondage_quote_worried_2: Stay calm. Blame the weather, the pollsters, then the weather again.
sondage_tutorial_goal: The map is a stylized France made of départements. You are the red camp, La Candidate leads the navy bloc. Whoever holds more than half of the map wins the election.
sondage_tutorial_rally: Each round you hold one rally: tap any free département. A small +n chip shows how many tiles a rally there would flip, and hovering a tile outlines them.
sondage_tutorial_flip: Flips work like Othello: in any of the eight directions, a line of rival tiles that ends at one of your tiles flips to you. A rally may also flip nothing.
sondage_tutorial_rival: Then La Candidate answers with a greedy rally: she always takes the tile that flips the most, and now and then she makes a gaffe.
sondage_tutorial_events: Random events shake up a round: a scandal freezes one rally for a round, a strike blocks a département for two rounds. Lines stop at both.
sondage_tutorial_win: There are no lives: the poll bar decides. Cross the middle marker first and the election is called at once. If nobody does, the larger share after the last round wins, and a tie goes to La Candidate.
sondage_tutorial_score: Score: 10 points per département held and 3 per flip; a win adds a bonus for every round you save.
sondage_result_reason_final: After the last round the poll reads {you} to {rival}.
sondage_result_reason_you_majority: You crossed the majority in round {round}.
sondage_result_reason_rival_early: Her bloc crossed the majority in round {round}, before the last round.
sondage_result_reason_rival_majority: Her bloc crossed the majority in round {round}.
sondage_result_map_label: Election map: you {you} départements, La Candidate {rival}, and the whole map swings to the winner
sondage_result_swing_you: The whole map swings your way!
sondage_result_swing_rival: The whole map swings to La Candidate!
sondage_cameo_message_win: A recount! I demand a recount! There is nothing to recount, but I demand it anyway.
sondage_cameo_message_lose: I thank everyone who voted for me, and several who did not. The sash looks wonderful on a winner.
mode_suez_description: A giant green container ship is wedged across a canal. Wiggle it free by dragging bow and stern, call the tiny excavator, and clear the line of waiting ships before they lose patience.
suez_playfield_label: Suez Stuck playfield. Drag the bow and the stern of the ship; tap a bank to call the excavator.
suez_ready_hint: The Ever Stuck is wedged across the canal. Grab its bow and stern and wiggle it free before the queue gets too long.
suez_tutorial_goal: The Ever Stuck is wedged across the canal with both ends dug into the banks. Swing it round until it points along the canal and floats clear, and it sails off.
suez_tutorial_drag: Drag the bow and the stern: each end stays exactly where you grabbed it. With two fingers you can hold both ends at once; with a mouse you drag the end nearest to the pointer.
suez_tutorial_banks: The mud holds the ship tight at first and it barely moves. Pull hard and wiggle back and forth to wear the stuck meter down. The banks push back, so a tilted ship has to turn to fit.
suez_tutorial_excavator: Tap a bank tile away from the ship and the tiny excavator digs it out, which loosens the ship. It needs a rest between scoops.
suez_tutorial_queue: Ships pile up behind you. If the queue gets too long, the captains give up and you lose a heart. Free the ship and the whole queue gets through.
suez_tutorial_score: Each canal you clear scores points, more for speed and for every ship in the queue. The next canal is narrower and the queue grows faster.
suez_popup_overflow: Ships take the long way round!
suez_cameo_alt: Cartoon of a worried ship captain in a green cap
suez_cameo_message: I said I would be through by lunch. Which lunch, I did not say.
mode_chipfab_description: Run a chip fab in two stages: stack silicon wafer layers with perfect timing, then merge memory modules from 4 GB upward. Big modules keep the shortage meter down, and Jason Huang of Novideo is watching while RAM and GPU prices go up.
chipfab_playfield_label_stack: Chip Fab Rush wafer stacker. Tap the field or press Space to drop the sliding layer.
chipfab_playfield_label_merge: Chip Fab Rush memory board. Swipe or use the arrow keys to slide the modules.
chipfab_ready_hint: Stage A: drop wafer layers so their edges line up. Stage B: merge the memory modules they yield. Keep the shortage meter low.
chipfab_tutorial_goal: Every level has two stages. In Stage A you stack a silicon wafer, in Stage B you merge the memory modules that wafer yields. Meanwhile the chip shortage keeps growing.
chipfab_tutorial_stack: Stage A: a layer slides back and forth above the tower. Tap the field, press Space or hit the button to drop it. Only the part that lands on the layer below stays, so the tower gets narrower with every sloppy drop. Land almost exactly on the edges for a perfect drop: nothing is cut off, and a streak makes the layers grow back. Miss completely and the wafer falls over.
chipfab_tutorial_merge: Stage B: swipe or use the arrow keys to slide all modules. Two modules of the same size merge into one twice as big: 4 GB, 8 GB, 16 GB and so on up to 1 TB. After every move one new module arrives from the wafer. The more layers and perfect drops you stacked, the more modules you get, and bigger ones show up more often. The stage ends when the modules run out and nothing can merge any more.
chipfab_tutorial_shortage: The shortage meter rises all the time, faster with every level. Perfect layers, finished wafers and modules of 16 GB or more push it down. When it reaches 100% you lose a heart; with no hearts left, the fab shuts down.
chipfab_tutorial_jacket: Jason Huang of Novideo is the boss in the leather jacket. He cheers on big merges and perfect stacks, and sulks when the shortage gets out of hand. He also sets the prices: RAM gets pricier per gigabyte the bigger the module, the GPU price only ever climbs, and a rising shortage marks everything up. The bigger your modules, the more the shortage eases.
chipfab_tutorial_score: You score for every layer, for perfect streaks, for finished wafers and for every module you create. Bigger modules are worth more.
chipfab_popup_wafer_done: Wafer done! {supply} modules for Stage B
chipfab_popup_wafer_fell: Wafer fell over! {supply} modules for Stage B
chipfab_jacket_alt_cheers: Cartoon of Jason Huang of Novideo, a bald tech boss in round glasses and a black leather jacket, cheering with a memory chip in his raised fist
chipfab_jacket_alt_neutral: Cartoon of Jason Huang of Novideo, a bald tech boss in round glasses and a black leather jacket, looking calm
chipfab_jacket_alt_sulks: Cartoon of Jason Huang of Novideo, a bald tech boss in round glasses and a black leather jacket, sulking under a small rain cloud
chipfab_cameo_message_cheers: Now that is a module! I am calling it a small step for memory and a giant leap for my jacket budget.
chipfab_cameo_message_sulk: Shortage is not a crisis. It is a pricing opportunity. Still, I am sulking, and I am wearing the jacket while doing it.
chipfab_cameo_message_sulk_2: I was promised a stack of perfect wafers. I got a stack of excuses. Fetch me a bigger jacket.
mode_vault_description: A memory game in a Swiss vault: pair gold bars, cheese wheels, watches and chocolate while a stern banker counts every mismatch. Three raised eyebrows cost a heart, and a ringing phone shuffles your cards.
vault_ready_hint: Flip two cards at a time and find the matching pairs. Every mismatch raises the banker’s eyebrow.
vault_popup_heart: Third eyebrow! A heart is lost
vault_banker_glare: That will cost you a heart.
vault_banker_alt: Cartoon of the banker, a stern man in a grey suit with a neutral face. Raised eyebrows: {count} of 3
vault_tutorial_goal: Gold bars, cheese wheels, watches and chocolate lie face down in a Swiss vault. Tap two cards to flip them: identical cards are a pair and stay open. Clear all pairs to open the next, bigger vault.
vault_tutorial_special: Special pair: a gold bar together with a cheese wheel also counts as a match and pays a big bonus.
vault_tutorial_banker: A stern banker watches every move. Each mismatch raises one of his eyebrows, and the third eyebrow costs a heart. A streak of three pairs in a row lowers an eyebrow again. With no hearts left, the vault closes.
vault_tutorial_phone: Now and then the vault phone rings. When the ringing stops, a few face-down cards swap places, so memorise fast and do not trust old guesses. Cards that are open or already matched stay put.
vault_tutorial_score: Every pair scores points, and longer streaks pay more. Clearing a vault gives a bonus, and a vault without a single mismatch gives a big extra bonus.
vault_cameo_alt_neutral: Cartoon of the banker, a stern man in a grey suit, with a perfectly neutral face
vault_cameo_alt_raised: Cartoon of the banker, a stern man in a grey suit, with both eyebrows raised very high
vault_cameo_message_neutral: Impressive. I will not say it twice, and I will not smile. The vault is, however, adequately open.
vault_cameo_message_raised: I raised one eyebrow, then another, and then I ran out of eyebrows. The vault is closed. Please take a number.
vault_cameo_message_raised_2: Gold, cheese, watches, chocolate, and you still found a way to disappoint me. That is a quiet kind of talent.
mode_veto_description: A reaction game around a table of five permanent seats: a silly draft resolution flashes, the seats hold up their cards, and you vote yes, abstain or veto before time runs out. A wrong vote costs a heart, streaks speed up the rounds, and ties go to the veto stamp.
veto_ready_hint: Count the five cards. Three alike decide the round. No majority? The veto breaks the tie.
veto_board_label: Security Council table with five permanent seats
veto_tutorial_goal: A silly draft resolution flashes at the table of the five permanent seats, and every seat holds up a card: aye, nay or meh. Look at the cards and pick your action before the clock bar runs out.
veto_tutorial_rules: Three alike decide the round: a majority of ayes means Vote yes, a majority of mehs means Abstain, a majority of nays means Veto. With no majority (two against two and one left over) the tie-break goes to the veto, and the stamp slams down.
veto_tutorial_lives: A wrong vote or a timeout costs a heart. With no hearts left, the session is adjourned.
veto_tutorial_speed: Every three correct answers in a row speed up the session and shorten the clock. A mistake slows it back down. Quick answers and long streaks pay more points.
veto_tutorial_keys: On a keyboard: 1 or Y votes yes, 2 or A abstains, 3 or V vetoes. P pauses.

mode_balloon_description: Hold to climb, release to sink: ride stacked wind layers across America as a very ordinary weather balloon. Dodge crows, storms, kites and patrol jets, snap weather photos and reach the east coast.
balloon_ready_hint: Hold the screen or Space to fire the burner and climb. Let go to sink. Every layer of sky has its own wind.
balloon_playfield_label: Wandering Balloon playfield. Hold to climb with the burner, release to sink, and pick the wind layer that carries you east.
balloon_tutorial_goal: You are a perfectly ordinary weather balloon, and you are drifting from the west coast to the east coast. Nothing to see here.
balloon_tutorial_burner: Hold the screen (or Space) to fire the burner and climb. Let go and you sink. The burner burns fuel, and the little hot-air puffs in the sky refill the tank.
balloon_tutorial_wind: The sky is stacked in five wind layers, each with its own speed and direction. Streaks and arrows show them, and the pattern reshuffles every stretch. Pick the fast layer, or beware the headwind.
balloon_tutorial_hazards: Crows, thundercloud, kites and patrol jets cost a heart. A jet crosses one layer after a warning arrow, so leave that layer in time. With no hearts left, the balloon is down.
balloon_tutorial_photos: Hover over a farm, a silo field, a very interesting lake or a stadium to snap a weather photo. Fast winds carry you past too quickly, so slow down for the shot.
balloon_tutorial_coast: The trip ends at the east coast, where a comically small missile pops the balloon. Every heart you have left is worth a bonus.
balloon_tutorial_keys: On a keyboard: Space, the up arrow or W fires the burner. P pauses.
balloon_cameo_alt: Cartoon of a round red weather balloon in sunglasses with a tiny basket
balloon_cameo_message_finished: Pop! Just a weather balloon, as stated. I checked: the wind, the lakes and the stadium were all thoroughly weather-related.
balloon_cameo_message_lost: I never made it to the coast. A crow looked at me, and the rest is meteorology. Nothing to see here, nothing at all.
mode_dome_description: Rockets arc toward a small cartoon city: tap them to launch interceptors, save the hospital first and never waste a shot on the sea. Ammo is limited, reloads are slow, waves get faster.
dome_ready_hint: Tap an incoming rocket to launch an interceptor. The dotted line shows where it will land: protect the buildings with the highest value and ignore the ones that land in the sea.
dome_playfield_label: Iron Dome Juggler playfield. Tap an incoming rocket to launch an interceptor at it.
dome_tutorial_goal: Rockets arc in from the sky toward a small cartoon city. Every hit on a building costs hearts, so keep the city standing for as many waves as you can.
dome_tutorial_tap: Tap an incoming rocket to launch an interceptor at it. The interceptor leads its target, so a tap is almost always a hit, as long as the rocket has not landed yet.
dome_tutorial_value: The faint dotted line shows where each rocket will land. The number on a building is its value: the hospital is worth 50 points and costs 3 hearts, the power plant 30 and 2 hearts, a house 10 and 1 heart. Saving a valuable building pays more.
dome_tutorial_harmless: Rockets that land in the sea, in the field or on a building that already lies in ruins are harmless. Do not shoot at them: a wasted interceptor costs 20 points and breaks your combo.
dome_tutorial_ammo: You only have four interceptors. They reload one at a time and there is a short pause between shots, so decide which rocket matters most.
dome_tutorial_power: If a rocket hits the power plant, the reloader goes dark and reloading is twice as slow for a few seconds.
dome_tutorial_combo: Every efficient intercept builds your combo and multiplies the points. A building hit, a wasted shot or a miss resets it. A wave without a building hit restores one heart and pays a bonus.
dome_tutorial_keys: On a keyboard: Space or Enter launches at the most urgent rocket. P pauses.
dome_cameo_alt: Cartoon of a tired operator with a headset, a coffee mug and a big red button in front of a small dome
dome_cameo_message_default: Shift report: every interceptor was fired in good faith. The funding request for more of them is still stuck in a committee that meets on Thursdays.
dome_cameo_message_wasteful: I fired at the sea again. The sea filed no complaint, but the accounting department did, and it was longer.
dome_cameo_message_far: Wave after wave, and not once did anyone ask how the coffee machine is doing. It is overheating. So am I.
mode_gpsliar_description: Jammers near Kaliningrad make your GPS lie. Steer a little cargo boat through the Baltic fog, trust lighthouses, buoys and gulls over the chart, and still deliver the herring and sauna stones.
gpsliar_intro: The GPS says you are on a runway. The fog says otherwise. Deliver the cargo anyway.
gpsliar_ready_hint: Drag on the sea to steer toward your finger, or use the arrow keys. The red dot on the chart is where the GPS claims you are. It is lying.
gpsliar_controls_hint: Drag to steer, or use arrows or WASD. C or Space cross-checks.
gpsliar_all_cleared: Every harbour served. The herring is fresh and the saunas are hot.
gpsliar_playfield_label: GPS Liar playfield. A foggy sea seen from above, with your cargo boat in the middle and a chart in the corner whose position dot lies. Drag to steer, or use the arrow keys.
gpsliar_tutorial_title: How to deliver with a lying GPS
gpsliar_tutorial_goal: Jammers near Kaliningrad send GPS positions haywire, and today the GPS thinks your boat is on an airport runway. Deliver herring and sauna stones to the harbours, in order, anyway.
gpsliar_tutorial_steer: Drag a finger (or hold the mouse) on the sea and the boat steers toward it: the farther away, the faster. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or WASD.
gpsliar_tutorial_chart: The chart in the corner shows the whole sea with its rocks, buoys, lighthouses and harbours. The red dot is where the GPS says you are. The error grows over time, jumps now and then, and on later levels the dot is even mirrored or turned around. The next harbour is circled.
gpsliar_tutorial_truth: Trust what you can see instead. The fog hides everything beyond a short radius, but lighthouse lights blink through it: a lighthouse flashes its number, one to four times in a row, so you can find it on the chart. Numbered buoys help too. The compass shows your heading, and the gulls always fly toward land.
gpsliar_tutorial_cross_check: The cross-check button (or C or Space) shows your true position as a green dot on the chart for a few seconds. You only get a few per level.
gpsliar_tutorial_hazards: Rocks, lighthouse islets, and the shadow-fleet tanker with its dragging anchor cost a heart, and you have three. The tanker is not on the chart. Shallows only slow you down, and the land is off limits.
gpsliar_tutorial_stars: One star for delivering everything, one for beating the par time and one for not using a single cross-check.
gpsliar_tutorial_keys: On a keyboard: arrows or WASD steer, C or Space cross-checks, P pauses.
gpsliar_cameo_alt: Cartoon of a little red cargo boat with a puzzled captain, parked on an airport runway
gpsliar_cameo_message: The GPS said we had arrived at the harbour. We had arrived at a runway. A small plane was very polite about it.
mode_leakpatrol_description: The West Wing pipes are leaking, and every leak is a leak: anonymous sources, memos, group chats. Hold your fingers on the drips to plug them, grab Sharpies, tape and CLASSIFIED folders, and say no to the group chat before a burst opens. Every news cycle is wetter than the last.
leakpatrol_ready_hint: Leaks drip in six rooms. Hold a finger on a leak to plug it, up to three at once. A room that fills up costs a heart.
leakpatrol_tip_dike: Tip: a boy in the Netherlands once saved a whole country with one finger in a dike. You get three.
leakpatrol_fingers_hint: Only {count} fingers count at once. Tools are the trick.
leakpatrol_board_label: Cross-section of the West Wing with six rooms
leakpatrol_leak_label: Leak in the {room}: hold to plug
leakpatrol_drip_label: Drip in the {room}: a leak is coming
leakpatrol_popup_untaped: The tape gave up in the {room}
leakpatrol_popup_absorbed: The CLASSIFIED folder soaked it up
leakpatrol_tutorial_goal: The West Wing pipes are leaking. Keep every room dry: when a room fills up, you lose a heart, and you have three.
leakpatrol_tutorial_hold: A drip blinks first, then the water flows. Press and hold a leak to plug it, and keep holding to fix it for good. Only three fingers count at once, so lift one to let a fourth take over.
leakpatrol_tutorial_tools: Tap a tool lying in a room to pick it up. The Sharpie seals a leak for good, tape seals it for 8 seconds, and a CLASSIFIED folder absorbs one burst. Pick the Sharpie or tape from the tray, then press a leak.
leakpatrol_tutorial_chat: Now and then a dialog asks "Add journalist to group chat?". Tap No before its bar runs out, or a big burst leak opens.
leakpatrol_tutorial_keys: On a keyboard: keys 1 to 6 hold a room’s leak (or pick up its tool), S and T take the Sharpie or tape, N says no, P pauses. Score: seconds survived times leaks plugged.
mode_tycoon_description: Tap the derrick, buy pumpjacks, tankers and a shadow fleet, and survive sanctions, protests and price spikes. The barrels keep flowing while you are away.
tycoon_playfield_label: Oil Tycoon playfield. Tap the derrick to pump barrels.
tycoon_producer_pumpjack_flavor: A nodding donkey that works for peanuts. Well, for barrels.
tycoon_producer_tanker_flavor: Carries oil from A to B. Officially.
tycoon_producer_refinery_flavor: Turns crude into profit, and into smoke.
tycoon_producer_lobbyist_flavor: One lunch with a committee, and the tax break writes itself.
tycoon_producer_shadowfleet_flavor: Fifty ships, three flags each, zero questions.
tycoon_producer_paperwork_flavor: Every barrel is certified as definitely not from there.
tycoon_producer_summit_flavor: A communiqué so long nobody reads it, and everyone profits.
tycoon_upgrade_effect_clickcps: Each tap also pumps {percent}% of your output per second
tycoon_upgrades_empty: No upgrades unlocked right now. Buy more producers to unlock new ones.
tycoon_ach_desc_producers: Own at least one of every producer
tycoon_achievements_summary: {count} of {total} unlocked. Each one adds {percent}% to all output.
tycoon_event_spike_text: Prices are soaring. Sell your stockpile now, or hold out and hope they climb higher?
tycoon_event_sanctions_text: New sanctions hit your producer: {producer}. Reflag the ships and dodge them, or lose that output for a while?
tycoon_event_pipeline_text: The inspectors are at the gate. Fix the pipeline now (slower output for a bit), or postpone it and hope nothing leaks?
tycoon_event_protest_text: Protesters have gathered around your derrick. Greenwash them with a shiny campaign, or wait it out while taps and output suffer?
tycoon_outcome_sanctioned: Sanctioned! That producer is offline for a while.
tycoon_outcome_fixed: Maintenance under way. Output is slower for a moment.
tycoon_outcome_leak: Leak! Output is crippled for a while.
tycoon_outcome_protest: Protesters block the derrick: no taps, less output.
tycoon_welcome_text: While you were away for {time}, your wells pumped {barrels} barrels.
tycoon_welcome_capped: Away time is credited for {hours} hours at most, at {percent}% speed.
tycoon_prestige_text: The state takes over and you start from scratch, but with a permanent bonus. Every point adds {percent}% to all output, forever.
tycoon_prestige_locked: Pump {amount} barrels in one run to earn your first point.
tycoon_prestige_confirm_text: You lose all barrels, producers and upgrades, and gain {points} points ({percent}% more output). Achievements and statistics stay.
tycoon_cameo_alt: Cartoon of a plump oil baron in a top hat with a monocle and a long cigar, hugging a barrel
tycoon_cameo_message: Nationalized? Nonsense! It is merely a temporary change in the paperwork.
tycoon_tutorial_title: How to run an oil empire
tycoon_tutorial_goal: Tap the derrick to pump barrels. Spend them on producers that pump for you every second. Each unit you buy makes the next one {percent}% dearer.
tycoon_tutorial_upgrades: Upgrades double what a producer or a tap makes, and some boost everything. They unlock as you own more.
tycoon_tutorial_crises: Every minute or so a crisis strikes: a price spike, sanctions, pipeline maintenance or a protest. You have a few seconds to answer. Safe answers cost barrels, risky ones can backfire, and if you do nothing the crisis takes its course.
tycoon_tutorial_offline: The wells keep pumping while you are away: up to {hours} hours, at {percent}% speed. The game saves itself.
tycoon_tutorial_prestige: Once a run is big enough you can nationalize and restart: you lose everything but gain permanent points worth {percent}% more output each. Every achievement adds {bonus}% as well.
mode_wordle_description: A daily five-letter word puzzle full of sanctions, energy and bureaucracy words. Six guesses, colour and symbol hints, a new word every day in your language, plus unlimited practice rounds.
wordle_tile_present: {letter}, in the word but in another place
wordle_notice_share_failed: Sharing did not work. Try copying the result by hand.
wordle_result_practice_won: Practice solved in {count} of {max} guesses. Practice rounds do not count for your stats.
wordle_result_practice_lost: The word was {word}. Practice rounds do not count for your stats.
wordle_tutorial_goal: Find the hidden five-letter word in six guesses. Type a word (or tap the keys) and press Enter. Every guess must be a real word from the word list of the game.
wordle_tutorial_colors: After each guess the tiles change: green with a check mark is the right letter in the right place, yellow with stripes and a ring is a letter that is in the word but in another place, grey with a cross is a letter that is not in the word at all.
wordle_tutorial_duplicates: Repeated letters count as often as they occur in the word: if you guess two Es and the word has one, only one of them is marked.
wordle_tutorial_daily: There is one daily puzzle per language, the same for everyone, and a new one opens at midnight. Your result, streak and statistics stay on this device. Practice mode gives unlimited random words and does not count.
wordle_tutorial_share: Share your result as a grid of coloured squares: it never shows a letter, so nobody gets spoiled.
wordle_tutorial_keys: On a computer you can type on your keyboard: Enter sends the guess and Backspace deletes a letter.
wordle_tutorial_letters_de: German: umlauts and ß are typed as AE, OE, UE and SS, so KÄSE is KAESE. Only words that are five letters long in this form are used.
wordle_tutorial_letters_fa: Persian: rows fill from right to left. Letters are written without diacritics, and Arabic ي and ك are read as ی and ک.
wordle_tutorial_letters_ar: Arabic: rows fill from right to left. Letters are written without diacritics; the alef forms أ إ آ count as ا, ة as ه, ى as ي, and ؤ ئ as و and ي.
wordle_tutorial_letters_uk: Ukrainian: use ґ, є, і and ї; words with an apostrophe are not used.
mode_maple_description: Steal the strategic maple syrup reserve of Quebec, politely. Push a barrel cart through the warehouse aisles, sneak past moose guards with vision cones and deliver the barrels to the truck. Ten stealth levels with stars and pancakes.
maple_intro: The strategic maple syrup reserve, guarded by very polite moose. Borrow a few barrels.
maple_all_cleared: The reserve is empty and the pancakes are legendary.
maple_pancakes_alt: A stack of {count} pancakes, one for every barrel delivered
maple_playfield_label: Maple Reserve Heist playfield. A warehouse seen from above with shelves, moose guards and your barrel cart.
maple_controls_hint: Arrows or WASD move the cart, Space or the dot key waits a turn. On a touch screen, swipe on the warehouse or use the buttons.
maple_tutorial_title: How to rob a very polite reserve
maple_tutorial_goal: In 2012 somebody really emptied the strategic maple syrup reserve of Quebec. Today that somebody is you: push your cart through the warehouse, pick up barrels and drive them onto the truck. A level ends as soon as enough barrels are on the truck (the quota in the top bar).
maple_tutorial_steer: Every step of the cart is one turn, and the moose take one step with you. Use the arrow keys, WASD, the direction buttons or swipe on the warehouse. The Wait button (or Space) lets a turn pass without moving, so the moose walk on.
maple_tutorial_cart: Barrels you pick up join the cart behind you like a snake, so you cannot drive back into your own barrels. From three barrels on, the cart is heavy: it creaks, and the moose get an extra step on every second move.
maple_tutorial_guards: Moose patrol their routes back and forth and see what is in front of them: one cell straight ahead, then three cells wide, as far as the red hatched cells show. Shelves block their view. The boss moose with the tiny tariff hat looks one cell further. Sneak up behind them or wait until they turn away.
maple_tutorial_spotted: A moose that sees any part of your cart says "Sorry!", costs you a heart, takes the barrels you carry back to the shelves and sends the cart back to the start. Barrels already on the truck stay there. When the last heart is gone, the heist is over.
maple_tutorial_stars: One star for getting every barrel on the truck (not just the quota), one for finishing at or under par moves and one for never being spotted. At the end you get one pancake for every barrel.
maple_tutorial_keys: On a keyboard: arrows or WASD move, Space or the dot key waits.
maple_cameo_alt: Cartoon of an apologetic moose in a tiny tariff hat in a maple syrup warehouse, next to a toppled barrel
maple_cameo_message: Sorry! Terribly sorry! We would never call the police, but we are very disappointed. Please return the barrels, and have a pancake.
mode_rareearth_description: Crates of rare earths pile up at the mines and every factory wants a different one. Switch the lanes to get each crate to the right factory before its deadline, while the ministry of export affairs keeps changing the rules: banned lanes, tariffs, quotas, licences. Every broken rule costs a heart.
rareearth_ready_hint: Tap a node to turn its switch to the next lane, or drag from it towards the lane you want. Get every crate to the factory that wants it before the deadline.
rareearth_tip: Tip: every notice comes with a warning period. Nobody has ever used it.
rareearth_board_label: Trade map: mines on the left, hubs and ports in the middle, factories on the right
rareearth_node_label: {node}: next stop {target}. Press to switch the lane.
rareearth_board_title: Notices of the Ministry of Export Affairs
rareearth_board_empty: No notices today. The ministry is drafting the next one.
rareearth_notice_ban: Notice 12-B: the lane {lane} is closed for administrative reflection. Crates that insist on using it will be confiscated and a form will be filed about it.
rareearth_notice_tariff: Notice 7-T: the lane {lane} now has a customs office with one very slow stamp. Crates crawl, and a delivery that paid the tariff does not count as by the book.
rareearth_notice_quota: Notice 31-Q: the lane {lane} may carry {limit} crates per round. The next crate is under review, which means confiscated.
rareearth_notice_licence: Notice 5-L: {element} needs a licence stamp at {node} before it reaches its factory. Forms in triplicate, stamps in quadruplicate.
rareearth_toast_rule_start: A notice is now in force
rareearth_tutorial_goal: Crates of rare earths spawn at the mines on the left. Each element belongs to one factory on the right: neodymium to the turbines, dysprosium to the EV motors, europium to the phones. Deliver every crate on time to the right factory.
rareearth_tutorial_route: Every node has a switch that points at one of its lanes, and crates follow it. Tap a node to turn the switch to its next lane, or drag from the node towards the lane you want. A crate waits a moment at its mine, so you can still set that switch.
rareearth_tutorial_rules: From round 2 the ministry issues notices. A banned lane confiscates every crate that enters it. A tariff makes a lane slow, and the delivery does not count as by the book. An export quota lets only a few crates per round through a lane. A licence means one element has to pass a checkpoint on its way. Each notice is announced a few seconds before it takes effect and expires after a few rounds. After a mistake the clerk flips that switch to a lane that is still allowed.
rareearth_tutorial_hearts: A broken rule, a missed deadline and a delivery to the wrong factory each cost a heart. You have three.
rareearth_tutorial_score: An on-time delivery scores points, more when it is quick. Deliveries that follow the rules build a combo: every three in a row raise the multiplier, up to x5. Any lost heart ends the combo. The pace rises every round.
rareearth_tutorial_keys: On a keyboard: Tab moves between nodes, Enter or Space turns the switch, the arrow keys turn it back and forth, P pauses.
rareearth_cameo_alt: Cartoon of a weary export office clerk with a huge rubber stamp, a tower of forms and a window that says Closed
rareearth_cameo_message_default: Your application has been processed. It was stamped, copied, filed and lost, in that order. Please resubmit in the next fiscal year.
rareearth_cameo_message_forms: You have broken so many rules that we had to print new forms for them. Congratulations, you are now a case.
rareearth_cameo_message_far: Round after round, and not one crate was late for the paperwork. The paperwork, however, is late for you. Come back tomorrow.
